2609.05976.title: Beyond Cross-Lingual Transfer: Benchmarking Propagation Boundaries in Multilingual LLM Unlearning
2609.05976.paper_summary: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning aims to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities. In multilingual settings, unlearning must additionally propagate within its intended linguistic scope. However, existing evaluations mainly measure cross-lingual transfer and cannot distinguish insufficient from excessive propagation. We introduce CLLPU (Cross-Lingual and Language-Bound Protocol for LLM Unlearning), a multilingual benchmark that formulates this problem through two settings: common-goal forgetting, where target knowledge should be suppressed across all languages, and language-conditioned forgetting, where suppression should remain confined to a designated language. CLLPU combines goal-guided topic pairing, schema-aware relation matching, and dual-anchor multilingual translation to construct 800 matched knowledge-unit pairs and 72,000 QA instances across ten languages. Experiments with six representative methods on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct reveal opposite failure modes: forgetting remains incomplete when universal suppression is required, yet spreads beyond the intended boundary when language-conditioned confinement is required. We further find that general multilingual utility can conceal damage to neighbor knowledge. These findings establish propagation control as a central challenge for multilingual LLM unlearning. We publicly release CLLPU together with its construction pipeline.
2609.05976.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）去學習旨在抑制目標知識，同時保留一般能力。<lb/>在多語言環境中，去學習還必須在其預定的語言範圍內進行傳播。<lb/>然而，現有的評估主要測量跨語言轉移，無法區分不足的傳播與過度的傳播。<lb/>我們引入了CLLPU（跨語言和語言綁定的LLM去學習協議），這是一個多語言基準，通過兩種設置來制定這個問題：共同目標遺忘，其中目標知識應在所有語言中被抑制，以及語言條件遺忘，其中抑制應保持在指定語言內。<lb/>CLLPU結合了目標引導的主題配對、模式感知的關係匹配和雙錨多語言翻譯，以構建800對匹配的知識單元和72,000個跨十種語言的問答實例。<lb/>在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上對六種代表性方法的實驗顯示出相反的失敗模式：當需要普遍抑制時，遺忘仍然不完整，而當需要語言條件限制時，卻超出了預定的邊界。<lb/>我們進一步發現，通用的多語言效用可能掩蓋對鄰近知識的損害。<lb/>這些發現確立了傳播控制作為多語言LLM去學習的核心挑戰。<lb/>我們公開發布CLLPU及其構建流程。
